reason: We have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for a decade without spending a rupee on software. Moving my staff and clients away from WhatsApp to a new platform introduces friction we simply do not need.
objection: Our entire workflow is already cemented in WhatsApp and Excel, and until client documents can be ingested directly from WhatsApp without asking clients to use web links, we won't change our habits.
would_change_my_mind: Direct WhatsApp group ingestion that automatically routes shared documents into our Google Drive folders without requiring clients to open external links.
